obligations.description: - `Tools.md` still leaves tool events under-attributed (`node_id`, `attempt_id`, actor/account/role, lane context missing), keeps the normalized outcome taxonomy unwired to actual event fields, and still lacks any real DAE post-hoc tool-event contract.
exact_items: - `Tools.md` still leaves tool events under-attributed (`node_id`, `attempt_id`, actor/account/role, lane context missing), keeps the normalized outcome taxonomy unwired to actual event fields, and still lacks any real DAE post-hoc tool-event contract.
